notes.title: Blood West v4.5
notes.content:
Hey there, Gunslingers - we got another update for ya today. And this one's a [b]doozy.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/ad83535540f368f7f959c3cc4d737028665d714a.png[/img]

First and foremost, as you may know, Blood West comes to you [b]from Poland with Love[/b] and as such it's part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/frompolandwithlove2025]From Poland with Love sale[/url] on Steam right now!

So we went ahead and made a new trailer for ya:

[previewyoutube=G4jukdHAiNU;full][/previewyoutube]
And no you're not hearing things, there's now [b]MORE[/b] voice lines in Blood West than ever before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/36151eddb517c222889425feb74f6ee2c0700df8.png[/img]
We've had over [b]50 new voice lines[/b] recorded by the legendary Stephen Russell as The Undead Gunslinger woven into the main campaign of Blood West to expand on both the lore of the land and his personal backstory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/24dd5b18950b39d680eab61ff146b5c947457d56.png[/img]
[i]Enjoy.[/i]

We've also added a [b]LONG[/b] requested localization, [b]Full PT-BR language support![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/04c570e9f327d1fca21099d5ce11227e3ef26493.jpg[/img]
[i]You're welcome.[/i]

Now... last December we released the expansion - [i]Blood West: Dead Man's Promise[/i] - and while y'all have certainly taken a liking to the adventure of Twen's father - [b]The Shaman[/b] - it seems we may have [i]over shot[/i] the price of this DLC a little bit. [b]So we're dropping the price... permanently![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3158590/Blood_West_Dead_Mans_Promise/
[quote][b]Blood West: Dead Man's Promise will now cost only $9.99 USD.[/b] And if you ever paid more than $9.99 please send an email with proof of purchase to admin@NewBlood.games and we'll either give you a key for one of our other games or refund you the difference. [i]Because We Love You and We Hate Money[/i] <3[/quote]
But wait, there's more!

You've been asking for the incredible Blood West loading screen art to be sold as art prints, so now for the first time ever they're available [url=https://newbloodstore.com/]on the New Blood Store![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/e85523aa42650b9862db92f656891395c85e00ba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/39363a3bd0e6ba9c0591761c137e613a3698ef5d.png[/img]

And last but certainly not least - we can finally announce that [b]The Blood West Original Soundtrack will be releasing on Steam and all digital storefronts on September 23rd![/b]

[previewyoutube=XF9zNpFcjwo;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Yee haw.[/i]

If you appreciate the work we do don't forget to leave a review and spread the good word of Hyperstrange and New Blood ːleatherneckː

[b]TL:DR[/b]

[list]
[*] New trailer
[*] PT-BR Language added
[*] New voice lines from Stephen Russell
[*] Dead Man's Promise price drop
[*] Art prints for sale
[*] Sountrack releases September 23rd!
[/list]
[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] More Voice Overs from Stephen Russell! - just like in Dead Man’s Promise (with the amazing Redd Pepper) the protagonist will comment on visited areas all around the map. 
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese - thanks to Gabriel Finotti, Blood West can now be experienced in another language. 
[*] Improvements to Cleansing Fire quest to make it a bit more intuitive (it’s enough to set skeletons on fire to progress)
[*] Slight optimization for some edge cases. This could be observed mostly when killing lots and lots of enemies without resting or dying. And in Chapter 3 in certain areas.
[*] Saving mid-dialogue is no longer possible to avoid potential issues.
[*] Added small bits of SFX to certain objects that were missing them
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a possible crash if player tried loading a save game where they declined the NG+ option
[*] Fixed an issue with flammable ammo not working correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where Molotovs wouldn’t be available at shops
[*] Fixed a bug in which summons didn’t work correctly in Dead Man’s Promise NG+
[*] Fixed a bug in which Golden Cigar would not appear in player’s inventory after starting NG+ if their inventory was full
[*] Fixed a bug where Cactus Bota wouldn’t prolong effects of alcohol. Also the item now mentions the duration in description properly.
[*] Fixed another bug where maxed out Alcohol Tolerance perk wasn’t prolonging effects of alcohol for the correct amount of time
[*] Fixed a bug with Depth Hunter’s ragdolls that could cause odd issues and graphical glitches
[*] Fixed a bug in which a dying Defiler wouldn’t spawn a Hellbat and instead would disappear if player stopped looking at it
[*] Fixed a bug where the C and D keybindings would instead bind to mouse buttons in certain cases
[*] Fixed a bug where an empty HUD element would appear if the player died with the Occult Mask on
[*] Fixed Priest’s coughing in Chapter 2. No more ghostly coughs after he moved on!
[*] Fixed a bug where the proper in-game cursor was lost to the Worlds Beyond. A successful expedition was mounted to retrieve the cursor from the unseen horrors.

notes.title: Blood West v4.3.0
notes.content:
Welcome back to the weird west yet again, gunslingers and shamans alike. We've got a [b]BIG ONE[/b] for ya today. v4.3.0 brings [b]new features, music, achievements, plenty of fixes and improvements[/b] and as you no doubt can already see... we're [b]Steam Deck Verified![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/4c31e2df93b9ef4d7d88162b3e13a49a0887c092.png[/img]

Moreover, we've finally added a [b]codex[/b] to keep track of all the notes you find in the game, so you can brush up on yer readin'! (and remind yourself which monsters are weak to what)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/185309bc66b2c7ffb0e7233ff03248f13b71b898.jpg[/img]
This will also let you know how many notes you're missing, for you completionists out there.

Speaking of completion - we've added *10* new achievements for Dead Man's Promise:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/71dd22215d0fa3d07301c7eb934da6ce5ad907f6.jpg[/img]\
[i]good luck Shaman...[/i]

[*] [b]NEW MUSIC[/b] at the Safe Zones! Something to soothe players' nerves and ease their burden whenever coming back from the Barren Lands.
[*] [b]NEW ARTIFACT![/b] If the player owns every single Ace card artifact, they can now be assembled into one. The ultimate Ace hand! Just click on any Ace card and select the “use” button to let the magic do the rest:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/9050f47ad5b104f8f76a37ebb9da4c6070e68a8a.png[/img]

[i]We've also done plenty more, so read on down... there's even a surprise at the end.[/i]

[b][u]Bug fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Chapter 1 boss would become unresponsive if the player performed save & load at the start of the boss fight
[*] Fixed an issue with the Rotten Skeleton’s incorrect behavior if his soul was sold and the player simply rested in a bed. 
[*] Fixed an issue where combination of Watch and Tentacle Cyst artifacts as well as maxed out Strong Lungs trait would allow player to “skip” from place to place
[*] Fixed an issue where the Doctor in Chapter 3 would not give his sidequest
[*] Fixed an issue with Alvaro’s Rib where it would grant different boost values than expected when combined with certain artifacts, perks or consumables
[*] Fixed an issue where Hangman’s Noose kill streak would be interrupted with a headshot when using any shotgun
[*] Fixed an issue where player was able to heal themselves with the Cursed Doll weapon by using its secondary attack on dead enemies’ heads (lol)
[*] Fixed an issue where it was impossible to remove certain weapons that required “death or Purple revival” even after dying if player died while holding a different weapon in hand
[*] Fixed an issue where players would take twice as mumch damage when landing on ladders or rope
[*] Fixed an issue where regular Cultists in Dead Man’s Promise would give a lot more Soul Essence than they should
[*] Fixed an issue where status effect icons would remain on screen when loaded into a new map and a dialogue was instantly triggered
[*] Fixed an issue where Hellfire Cultist's would have a second heart as a loot even after his heart was already stolen using pickpocketing
[*] Lots of controller related issues have been fixed
[*] Few language improvements have been added as well
[/list]
[b][u]Improvements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Font size has been scaled up - this change is both for PC and Steam Deck and should make everything much easier to read. This also means Blood West is officially Steam Deck verified!
[*] Added “drop item” functionality for controllers - default bind can be changed in the Settings menu
[*] Added an option to change default metric units from meters to [b]paces[/b]. [i]For immersions sake :)[/i]
[*] Added a launch parameter “-nogamepad” on Steam - when used, it disables any non-keyboard/mouse inputs that could in specific cases cause issues. To enable it, just enter the command in the Launch Options in Blood West’s properties on Steam.
[*] Chapter 2 boss is now slightly tougher and a bit more aggressive (rawr)
[*] Lady Anabelle or The Priest will offer discounts to their wares if given the cure (mind you, this will only affect games where the player didn’t give the Cure to any of those characters yet)
[*] Purple Revival now removes Blessings as well
[*] Resolution in the Settings menu is now a proper dropdown list
[*] Improvements to the input system to better handle certain cases like when player uses AZERTY keyboard layout and changes certain keybinds
[*] Totem of Souls voice is now more “spectral” (at Gianni's request)
[*] Improvements to the quest tracking and journal entries for a few Chapter 2 quests 
[*] A slew of small SFX improvements
[/list]

[i]Because it's comin' at ya.[/i]

notes.title: Dead Man's Promise FAQ
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome undead gunslingers and spirit talkers alike. 
Welcome to the Dead Man's Promise FAQ.[/h3]

You've got questions? [b]Well, we've got answers.[/b]

But first... here's a message from The [b]Shadow Man[/b] himself, the voice of [b]The Shaman [/b]in [i]Dead Man's Promise[/i], the one and only... [b]Redd Pepper[/b]:

[previewyoutube=_60A7O0mI4k;full][/previewyoutube]
And now, onto your most [b]Frequently Asked Questions...[/b]

[h3][b]General Questions[/b][/h3]

Q: [i]Is Dead Man’s Promise a [i]standalone[/i] expansion or is it now part in the main campaign story?[/i]

A: DMP is a standalone expansion, played separately from the main campaign. But it is launched from the main menu of Blood West. [b]It does not have its own .exe or app on Steam.[/b]

Q. [i]Do I need to own Blood West in order to play Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A. [b]YES.[/b]

[i]Q: Is it required to finish the main campaign before playing DMP?[/i]

A: No! But it is encouraged to at least finish Chapter 2 to get some good background on who you'll be playing as in Dead Man's Promise and why. Plus you'll be more prepared!

[i]Q: Can I play Dead Man's Promise with my character from the base game?[/i]

A: No. Dead Man’s Promise features a NEW character together with a NEW set of weapons and skills to use.

[i]Q: Is Dead Man's Promise a prequel or sequel to the main game?[/i]

A: It’s kind of in the middle. The Shaman's story takes place around when the player in the main campaign leaves to go to Chapter 3. [b]Think of it as a side story from Chapter 2.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/dfc1da28d2be252559a0ccc09dab012f0f208d73.jpg[/img]
[i]Q: How long will it take to beat Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: Hard to say, but about the same as the other chapters of Blood West. Your mileage may vary!

[i]Q. How much will it cost?![/i]

A. $14.99 but existing owners of Blood West will be able to get it for $9.99 at launch :)

[i]Q: Will there be new content for the main campaign, too?[/i]

A: Together with Dead Man's Promise we will be releasing a patch with some Quality of Life Improvements and are already planning to do more in the future (along with more DLC)

[i]Q: Will this expansion release in Early Access?[/i]

A: No, it will be fully released as a proper expansion!

[i]Q: What translations/languages will be available?[/i]

A: The same as the base game, so: English, German, Polish, Hungarian and Russian

[i]Q: When will Dead Man's Promise release?![/i]

A: SOON™ (Sooner than you think)

[h3][b]The Map[/b][/h3]

[i]Q: What does the map look like? Is it the same map as the swamps from Chapter 2?[/i]

A: No! It's a brand new map - although it is also a [i]bog[/i], so it may look a bit similar at first glance...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/2eaeef82b1b10bf0b2ac40911fa26704abc5458c.png[/img]
[i]Q: How big is the map?[/i]

A: Think of it as the size of Chapter 1 but packed packed with [b]much[/b] more content!

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]

[i]Q: Will there be new traits?[/i]

A: Yes! 12 new traits await you in total to build your own version of The Shaman.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/faf291a1746459ac18f14325560eef1b3152ff3f.png[/img]
[i]Q: How many new weapons and artifacts are there in Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: Over 40! Including [b]new [/b]weapon types.

[i]Q: How about monsters, how many [b]new[/b] dangers lurk in the swamps of Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: 11 new enemies await, plus some old favorites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/2d5c639ecf89dd584c336a351c76162adae19c05.jpg[/img]
[i]Q: What else is [b]new[/b] in Dead Man's Promise?[/i]

A: New status effects, the ability to [b]summon allies[/b] to your aid, traps and more!

[i]Q: How about lore?![/i]
 
A: Of course there will be quite a few new things to lay your weary eyes upon and maybe even some revelations on how the world of Blood West works!

[h3][b]Other Assorted Questions[/b][/h3]

[i]Q. Is Dead Man's Promise harder than Blood West?[/i]

A. Of course! Expansion packs are always harder than the base game? MUHAHAHAHAHA

[i]Q: Will there ever be a map editor or anything like that? [/i]

A: No

[i]Q: Official mod or Steam Workshop support?[/i]

A: Not right now...

[i]Q: Multiplayer? Co-op?[/i]

A: Sorry!

[i]Q: Steam Deck Verification?![/i]

A: Working on it!

[i]Q. New Game+?[/i]

A. Wouldn't that be fun...

[i]Q: Roguelite Randomizer Mooncrash Style DLC?![/i]

A: Not a bad idea...

notes.title: Blood West Survey Results
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy Gunslingers![/h1]


Today we would like to share with you the hot takes  of the survey that we have posted in some time ago. But before that, we would like to thank y'all for being such mighty fine folk! [b]Your turnout has surpassed our wildest expectations - tip of the hat to you! For people like you, give us the positive energy to keep making more![/b]

[h3]With that out of the way, let's take a look together at these fancy numbers![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/1b56399f1510d3fef0ec272d21861a8e675fffe1.png[/img]

[h2]Favorite NPC[/h2]

Anabelle won by a landslide and we ain’t surprised! We fell in love with the gal while she was still a concept art during the development of the second chapter of Blood West and we wanted her to be the poster-girl of the second chapter. That wouldn’t be possible of course without Ivy Wilde. She did done a fantastic job of bringing the character to life and on that note each and every voice actor did a phenomenal job.[b] In case you were wondering who is  the voice behind your favorite NPC, here is a neat little homage we made for them.
[/b]
[previewyoutube=A2LsU9J7NPE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Best Chapter[/h2]

An almost equal split between chapters sends us a clear message of what tickles your fancy when it comes to level design. Open levels with a strong theme, lots of small pockets of interest to explore and a fair, yet demanding difficulty curve. We could pat ourselves on the back here and call it a day, but there is the topic of Chapter 3. A disclaimer before we dig in, as almost 40% of participants stated that they have not finished Blood West yet - and with the difficulty spike we ain’t surprised. Nevertheless, this bit of information paints Chapter 3 in a much different color. However, we wouldn’t be ourselves, if we hadn't looked at everything thoroughly. There could be several factors that contributed to his result, the aforementioned difficulty spike, gaming fatigue, elevations interrupting the flow of exploration and a few others. We will be looking at each and one of them to make sure nothing is overlooked - just in case. Overall, we are happy with all of the chapters as they have done their very distinctive jobs very well - otherwise your reviews wouldn’t be so positive. So we take this task with an attitude of how to make a good thing even better.


[h2]Favorite Gameplay Style[/h2]

Almost equal split between gunsling and sneaking! I reckon with these results we can hazard a statement that we have done good on the Stealth FPS part. Yet there is no rest for the undead and game developers as it looks like archery and melee is lagging be-hind in your estimations. While there are more than several perks and trinkets that amplify these gamestyles there seems not to be enough of them. The same thing goes for weapon variety - there weren't simply as many bows and melee weapons as guns. Luckily, the solution for this here challenge is quite simple - make more of em’! We have not only already planned a greater number of these types of weapons for upcoming content, but we have also been working on making their passive and active effects as engaging and fun as we can. Hell, you might even see a whole new kind of weapon - but you did not hear it from me.

[b]On a bit of an off-topic, how do you feel about our archetype videos?[/b] [b]Would you like to see more of them? Let us know in the comments![/b]

[previewyoutube=Jc-1O-t2tgA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Most Wanted Improvements[/h2]

While there are some interactive environments in Blood West, shoutout to those cowboys who found the destructible lanterns, there certainly could be more of them. However, this is the part where we have to cool your horses folks. Adding physics to many objects is something that can’t be done in how we have built Blood West - performance will kick the dirt simply. So while a substantial expansion of the scope of interactive environments is a topic for a far, faaar future, we can definitely deliver the second most wanted thing -  more mechanics! You can bet your last penny that we will keep experimenting with making monsters in Blood West even more complex and creepy, but you can also expect us to keep expanding gameplay archetypes. For what are new enemies without new weapons to unalive them. 


[h2]Most Wanted Future Content[/h2]

They say the customer is always right, so who are we to argue? [b]Round up your crew and mosey on over to this here steam page on the 19th of August[/b]. Keep your pretty peepers focused around 19.00 CEST and you might just find what you were asking for. 


[h1]See you soon partners![/h1]

notes.title: Blood West Monster Art Contest: Unveiling the Champions!
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy Gunslingers[/h1]

The day we’ve all been waiting for is finally here! We're bursting with excitement to crown the victors of our biggest and most thrilling contest ever!

Remember when we challenged you, our incredible community, to unleash your inner monster-maker? To conjure up the most intriguing, spine-tingling creature to stalk the barren lands of Blood West? Well, the wait is over!

As a reminder, the winner’s design will be immortalized within the game and their name will take the rightful place in the Blood West credits! Talk about legendary!

And for the three runner-up masterminds, their phenomenal creations haven't gone unnoticed. Each of them will receive a double dose of gaming glory: two game keys from our selection, a well-deserved reward for your fantastic work.

Drumroll, please...

The moment you've all been craving: the winning entries!


[h1]MAIN PRIZE WINNER[/h1]

[h2]Wraith Wolf by Emmanuel Falaras[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/b5ccaacdd9f90decfe968233e595acba8695aad5.png[/img]

[i]These woods used to echo with the sounds of the Wolf Packs around here. But as Ranchers and
Frontiersmen settled in, they were wiped out, hunted to oblivion. Now though, since the dead have been rising again, the Wolves have come back... And they seem intent on returning the favor.

There are two variants of the Wraith Wolf, the Alpha, and its Summons.

The Alpha is a Skeletal Wolf with a ghostly body, and glowing eyes and heart. And the Summon is the
Skeleton with only the glowing eyes. The Wraith Wolf Alpha starts patrolling its territory alone. But when it engages with a target, the Alpha howls, summoning additional skeletal wolves around itself that attack the target directly. While the Summons attack the target, the Alpha circles from the outside, quickly darting back and forth, occasionally stopping to summon additional skeletons at different
angles around its target. The Skeletal Summons pull themselves from the ground when spawned, and are brittle, falling relatively easily with no damage resistances. The Alpha is heavily resistant to all damage types outside of Silver, with the glowing heart acting as a greater weak point as opposed to the head. When the Alpha is defeated, any active Summons also fall with it. When defeated, the Alpha's ghostly body evaporates while the bones fall to the ground, and the Skeletal Summons simply fall to the ground.

The Wraith Wolf may drop its Jaw on death as an equipable item. When worn, it will summon two
skeletal wolves to aid the player in combat once every 5 minutes. The skeletal wolves, and the item
cooldown are both triggered when an enemy targets the player. The goal of the Wraith Wolf is first, to have more Spectral enemies to encourage greater use of Silver Ammo. Second; to be an enemy encounter that offers many targets to fight at once, giving more value to high-capacity weapons like the Lever Rifle and the Chain Pistol. And thirdly; to have an enemy that offers a more intense, faster paced combat if the player seeks it, or to be a dangerous enemy rewarding a stealthy play style.[/i]


[h3]And here’s what the team said about giving this concept a key to being animated in Blood West:[/h3]

“The Wraith Wolf's concept as a whole captivates us; the synergy between its design, mechanics, and lore creates an exceptional entity. While each element on its own is strong, it's their cohesive integration that truly stands out. Among many impressive submissions, it stood out and clinched the team's vote. It's a perfect fit for Blood West's varied biomes, enhancing the game's "wild" areas seamlessly. The creator aimed to introduce a spiritual foe encouraging more use of silver ammo, a touch we find brilliant. Essentially, the Wraith Wolf triumphed by melding a striking visual idea with game mechanics as if tailor-made for Blood West.”


[h1]RUNNER-UPS[/h1]

[h3]Here are the three masterpieces that earned the second prize![/h3]

[h2]Tombstone Scorp by Pavel Pavlenko[/h2]

[h2]Tormentor by Cormac Bate[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/8ed2a4c00155fd8139e287061acf331d75d4fddf.png[/img]

The Blood West Team[/h3]

notes.title: Blood West Chapter 3 Teaser
notes.content:
[h1]Gunslingers![/h1]

We know you’re eagerly looking forward to our full release coming December 5th, 2023. So are we! To sweeten the waitin’ game, we’ve prepared some sneak peaks of what comes after yet another summoning of your infamous outlaw in Blood West: Chapter 3!

If you’ve yet to play our Wild West game, [b]the current Steam Stealth Fest might be a great excuse to pick up Blood West for 25% OFF[/b]... to catch up with all the menaces haunting Barren Lands and the Swamps. And prep yourself to head to the Mountains. How dangerous could they be?

[h1]What comes in Chapter 3[/h1]

[b]If you’re a greenhorn, beware as there’re spoilers ahead![/b] As you remember, our next stop will be the Mountains. They’re covered with dark forest, hiding loads of new varmints and secrets, where with each step our desperado can stumble upon a swarm of glowing-red spirits. Apart from the omnipresent trees and branches, a [b]whoppin’’ rift[/b] can be spotted, with even more enemies awaitin’ anyone daring to enter it. And once you do, the air can get a bit more… demonic. [b]A worn-out railway[/b] sprawling across the location is not to be missed, one can only wonder where it might lead. Both seem quite fitting to the mountain setting [b]unlike a circus that can be spotted[/b] in the distance. Its presence itself has a mysterious aura, as what’s even going on here. All this and more unravels before your eyes as you arrive with your newfound companion, in quite unlucky circumstances – this new level brings quite a few fresh additions to your favorite bloody lore. Being the final episode, we’ll draw a conclusion to the story of your well known dudes and dudettes, what the future holds for them is up to you, Gunslingers!

[previewyoutube=-QdWd3v7eEo;full][/previewyoutube]
Don’t be buffaloed by a dark night in the desolate woods giving you peaceful vibes, as there’s plenty of varmints rumbling around. Same as Chapter 2 did, another installment introduces a new variety of monsters! We’re keeping most of them as a surprise, but with the promised sneak-peak comes an introduction to the Demon! [b]The skittering sound of  the steps of its stilts-like legs are bloodcurdling to anyone nearby.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/d792a221e3220ad5f036c1653b401d16bae0c712.jpg[/img]

It dwells in places often shrouded in dark vapors that are detrimental to the health of the living beings. It’s known for tirelessly stalking its prey, and, in spite of its size, it cuts dirt devilishly fast. We don’t have any evidence that this slightly hunched monstrosity is an inhabitant of Hell, but we can assure you it can be hella tricky to defeat as it can discharge devastatin’ ranged attacks. Just look at these four upper limbs! Beware as in melee fight they’re capable of rippin’ you to flinders. [b]During the fight, the Demon also takes advantage of the vapors that tend to surround its lairs.[/b]

Even tho’ we throw you into the deep end with all this new spawn of monsters, you won’t go around unprepared as you’ll have plenty of chances to get some new barking irons, legendary weapons included. No matter if you’re more of a gunslinger or an archer, we have you covered with fire-new weaponry.

[previewyoutube=1Qhu6hwpvik;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready for [b]Sentence[/b], whose previous owner was a self-proclaimed judge, traveling through different villages looking for those who are dodging the law. Each blow meant yet another judgment executed. Once equipped it can’t be taken-off and for each slain foe you will recover a bit of health.

Moreover you may find[b] Spite[/b], a unique bow covered in thorns and spikes. It does not require ammunition as it draws blood from the player and forms it into arrows - so you have to be sure not to overdraw the string. Arrows shot with it defy laws of physics, which makes them hellishly accurate. Furthermore,  as you’re struggling to hold it with all its stingy surface, you could swear you can hear a faint chuckle from within.

And here is the kicker, [b]both of these weapons interact with a new phenomenon found in Chapter 3 - the hell vapors[/b]. Once within their reach these weapons unlock new powers. For the Sentence, almost each shot becomes a critical shot, while Spite no longer damages you when used. 

[h3]All this and more comes to all of you in less than five months, till then
Good fortune, partners![/h3]

[*] Backup saves - The game will now keep backups of 3 last saves. Save will be performed additionally on each player death and during resting.

[*] Consistency updates - Items will now have the same color of name in the inventory and on tooltip while picking them up from ground also when traveling from chapter 1 to chapter 2 the stash will keep position / orientation of items stored there.

notes.title: Welcome to Blood West, gunslingers!
notes.content:
[h2]Gunslingers![/h2]

Today, we wish to invite you to [b]Blood West early access[/b]. Our immersive survival-horror FPS will have you exploring twisted wild west environments, scavenging for supplies, hunting deadly monstrosities, and gaining power to face terrifying bosses. The game is [b]priced at $14.99 in the early access[/b] period, and the pioneers getting it in the launch week will also enjoy a special 20% release discount. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West/

Note - [b]Blood West[/b] game is already feature-complete, polished, and packed with content. The Early Access begins with the first out of three planned expansive areas to explore, each with its own non-linear scenario.

[h2]What is Blood West?[/h2]

[b]Blood West[/b] is a stealth shooter inspired by such classics as [b]S.T.A.L.K.E.R., Thief, System Shock, Deus Ex, or Blood[/b], but also hugely influenced by Crytek's excellent online title - [b]Hunt: Showdown[/b], while being a strictly single-player experience itself. There's a lot of ways to describe it, but it is best that you see for yourself -  here's a chunky, 25-minute developer-gameplay, going through one of the first quests and showcasing some basic, and more advanced mechanics:

[previewyoutube=iO6UmF0-9FU;full][/previewyoutube]
(No, the protagonist doesn't speak as much in the game as in the video - it's just the commentary that was recorded by Jake Parr, who also voices the Revenant Gunslinger in the game).

To sum up the Blood West experience in a few bulletpoints:
[list]
[*] Blood West is not a non-stop action-focused velocity shooter. It's best taken slow, and thoughtfully, with sneaking, surveying the surroundings, planning your attacks, and going head-first into combat only when you're sure you're at an advantage.
[*] Combat mechanics in Blood West are more complex than you might expect. Enemies have weak spots (usually the head), and can take a lot of damage before dying, unless you use their vulnerabilities.
[*] Weapons have different stats, and usually guns that you loot from the enemies or find discarded somewhere, are old and rusty, and won't perform great. There are also different types of ammo, and some are more effective against certain enemy types than the others.
[*] Your character - the Revenant Gunslinger - gains experience, and levels up. When that happens, you get some skill points to distribute unlocking very useful perks in the character screen. Different perk+weapon combinations allow for very different approaches to the game. Try different playstyles!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41048939/57d196807f05ede2d1ba5bb17fdb690f295401aa.png[/img]

That should get you on the right track. Do pay attention in the tutorial area - it's short but it will do a good job introducing you to the basics. Now, we'll let you discover everything else in the game by yourself. Good luck!

[h2]Why Early Access?[/h2]

[b]Blood West[/b] is a complex game with some sandbox gameplay, and a lot of moving parts. We would love to see how you'll be playing it, what will be your approach to its many challenges, and what will be your thoughts on the game's world, systems, and general experience.

At Hyperstrange we've had the best of experiences with involving the Steam community in the development process, by including them in our work cycle through Early Access. Games like [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/727850/ELDERBORN/]ELDERBORN[/url][/b] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811320/Jupiter_Hell][b]Jupiter Hell[/b][/url] wouldn't be what they are today, if it wasn't for your involvement. We want to approach [b]Blood West[/b] the same way.

While we have a complete and quite precise vision of the game in our minds, we know we can make it even better by giving ourselves space to work with your feedback. We're hoping to hear from you here, in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1587130/discussions/]Steam Hub Forums[/url], but most of all we're eager to talk with you on [url=https://discord.gg/5fCZK562jT][b]Hyperstrange Discord[/b][/url].

[h2]How long Blood West will remain in Early Access?[/h2]

Long story short - we expect to put another 6-8 months into development, before releasing in full, with two substantial content updates, one adding the second of three planned scenarios, and the third adding the final scenario bringing the game to full release. 

[h2]Why is the demo gone?[/h2]

Some of you keep asking that question. We've decided to say farewell to the [b]Blood West Demo[/b] that we've introduced 4 months ago during Steam Next Fest. While we understand that this will disappoint some of you, we think that the outdated demo did not represent the game properly, and was doing us a disservice. While it did a great job giving Steam players a taste of what [b]Blood West[/b] is, it was very limited in terms of content and mechanics, and did not present the level of polish we were aiming for. We don't want anyone to play it and assume that that's all there is to the actual game.

[h2]Good luck![/h2]

Here begins the Ballad of the Revenant Gunslinger, a wicked soul roaming the curse-tainted frontier, looking for a way to destroy a greater, eldritch evil, holding the land in its clutches. Now, this is your story, too.
[previewyoutube=Vf2Jqq_QFg0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Enjoy your time with Blood West, and take back the frontier, gunslingers![/h3]

notes.title: Thank you for an amazing Steam Next Fest 2021, folks! We're keeping all the demos for you to play longer!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/8215daa0ebcca22bfc64465d6831bd30c2ba0ede.png[/img]

As [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] draws to a conclusion we want to thank everyone for stopping by and trying out our demos. We've had tens of thousands people playing the featured games, hundreds joining our [b][url=https://discord.gg/AqQ5Cc8UkA]community Discord[/url][/b] to offer feedback, and posting on social media! 

Many of you have been asking "will I be able to keep playing the demo after Next Fest ends"? Steam suggests all Next Fest demos should be timed, to create a sense of urgency and make sure the players wishlist the game. But this is simply not the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/pub/Hyperstrange]Hyperstrange[/url][/b] way. We're old enough (well, some of us) to remember shareware times, when demos came on floppies and lasted forever (well, some of them). Cutting to the chase: the demos stay, at least until their respective games get released. Here's what you can play, in case you missed some of them:

[h1]RAYZE[/h1]
[previewyoutube=lsYO7QOS6aE;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE][b]RAYZE[/b][/url]  is a genre-defying hyper-paced music-filled first-person AIM RACER. Hit a target to accelerate. Miss and you slow down. Hit a wall and die. Find the fastest route. Get to the finish line. Simple? Yes. Easy? Hell no. Who said training to be your own aim-bot can't be fun? Welcome to your new casually hardcore obsession!

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689190/RAYZE][b]DEMO[/b][/url] consists of the entire first sector of the game, that's 5 tracks for you to figure out and master, one bite-size FPS speedrun at a time. Achievements to unlock, global leaderboards to compete with friends and strangers... Just two more weeks until full release! Ready? 3... 2... 1... Let's RAYZE!

[h1]Blood West[/h1]
[previewyoutube=hnr5wWsnJ6w;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West][b]BLOOD WEST[/b][/url], an immersive Wild West FPS where a revenant desperado takes on the twisted demons and eldritch horros in a cursed, desolate mining town. Hell is empty and all the devils are here! Plan your steps, be stealthy, gain advantage, manage your resources, and paint the world dark red! Blood West was the second most-played Hyperstrange demo in Steam Fest, and there's already many players telling us they cannot wait for the release, despite the game being brutally hard! If you missed the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587130/Blood_West][b]DEMO[/b][/url], you can still try, and if you like the experience of being the Revenant desperado, please [b]remember to add the game to your wishlist[/b]!

[h1]Supplice[/h1]
[previewyoutube=03gC5zFgKk0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice]Supplice[/url][/b] is a stylish throwback shooter that made a lot of people happy during the Steam Next Fest. inspired by the mid-90s FPS glory days and the legendary Doom modding community. Mixing the retro stylings of 90s era shooters with colorful graphics and frantic gameplay, it creates an experience that's ever so familiar but also exciting and fresh. The team behind the game is a real hot pot of Doom modding and FPS development legends, starting from Brett 'Mechadon' Harrell, the project founder, through Aleksander 'Cage' Kowalczyk, the lead artist also known for his work with [i]Ion Fury[/i], to James 'Jimmy' Paddock, the lead composer, known from his midi soundtracks to Sigil, Prodeus, and many other talents. Please check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693280/Supplice][b]DEMO[/b][/url] and follow & add the game to your wishlist if you want to stay up to date with its development.

[h1]Skullstone[/h1]
[previewyoutube=ias1aZwsHRU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693290/Skullstone]Skullstone[/url][/b] is a true to its form dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, real-time tactics combat, and first-person view. Lead a party of adventurers into the under-realm, looking for glory, gold, and a solution to the ancient evil plaguing the town above. A real stand-out in the FPS action-focused Hyperstrange catalog - why not give it some appreciation by playing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1693290/Skullstone][b]DEMO[/b][/url] and wishlisting this pure-blooded classic RPG.


[h1]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/h1]
[previewyoutube=aSEnsSkkRRs;full][/previewyoutube]
Last, but in no way the least in our Steam Next Fest lineup, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged][b]POSTAL: Brain Damaged[/b][/url] dominated the First-Person Shooter category, reaping the most wishlists and getting over 20 000 demo downloads. If by some strange twist of fate you're here but you don't know what is POSTAL: Brain Damaged... it's a spin-off of the Running With Scissors cult series, firmly rooted in the POSTALVERSE, but taking more gameplay cues from modern shooters such as the latest DOOM, than the fan-acclaimed POSTAL 4, the latest entry in the main series. This time around the story follows POSTAL DUDE on a journey through the dark and bizarre landscape of his own mind, which gives the developer a chance to explore new depths of weirdness, madness, and gore. The gloves are off! See for yourself - play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged][b]DEMO[/b][/url] and make sure to hit that wishlist button hard! [i](Please note that as we focus on developing the game, we won't be able to update the demo, so it will reflect the state of development in September 2021, even if you play it in May 2022, when the game is getting released. Expect improvements and changes!)[/i]

As we wrap-up the event, we feel immensely grateful to the wonderful Steam player community who show us so much appreciation. Please keep your feedback coming - if you have any to offer, please join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/AqQ5Cc8UkA]community Discord[/url][/b]. We strive to make your live stranger and filled to the brim with good old action, and it's such a rush to see that you enjoy what we bring to your screens. That is it for today,[b] be excellent to each other![/b]

[b]Yours truly,[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38371631/0703e4c0718a8efe5be90b59356042bc0910a9e2.png[/img]

[b]Hyperstrange[/b] was one of the most notable studios/publishers at [b]Realms Deep 2021[/b]. True to our roots, we treat the "boomer-shooter con" as our main event of the season. Yes, with the amazing help and support we've received from the organizers (3D Realms, New Bloods, and others), Realms Deep is our E3 this year. And it wouldn't be a E3-styled event if we didn't announce a whole lot of stuff. Did you miss it? Here's what went down!

[h1]New Hyperstrange studio games announced[/h1]

[previewyoutube=hnr5wWsnJ6w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Hyperstrange publishing projects revealed[/h1]

[h1]New HOT release[/h1]
[previewyoutube=tp_uizEnIes;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/811320/Jupiter_Hell][b]Jupiter Hell[/b][/url] is a turn-based shooter from the depths of cosmic hell, built on a classic roguelike framework updated with modern 3d graphics. Rip and tear zombies, demons, and heavy metal monstrosities with chainguns and chainsaws. Like chess... with shotguns! This spiritual successor to Doom Roguelike launched in full on August 5 to both player and media acclaim. “[i]A Turn-Based Triumph - Jupiter Hell is an engaging and commendable recreation of DOOM's style in turn-based roguelike form that will please just about everyone[/i].” writes [b]Screen Rant[/b], giving the game 4,5/5 stars, while [b]Kotaku[/b] calls it "[i]an absolute gem[/i]".

First announced at Realms Deep 2020 in early pre-alpha stage, it quick became somewhat of an obsession with the POSTAL community, and there's a lot of people who have been asking, no, demanding to see some final-quality gameplay footage. That's exactly what we delivered at Realms Deep 2021... plus something extra. If you are a POSTAL fan or a general boomer-shooter enjoyer, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359980/POSTAL_Brain_Damaged]please add Brain Damaged to your wishlist[/url] and follow the project, so you don't miss the chance to play the Demo that will be featured on [b]Steam Next Fest this October[/b]!

[previewyoutube=qSXR4Yf86Tg;full][/previewyoutube]

Today marks the 100 000 Steam purchases milestone for Frozenheim. That's [b]one hundred thousand[/b] Vikings in our Frozen North! This is the second game in our catalog to reach the 100k player tier, following our debut title, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/727850/ELDERBORN][b]ELDERBORN[/b][/url][/b], which - as per our Realms Deep announcement is coming soon to Xbox (alongside our bite-size FPS, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1329540/CROSSBOW_Bloodnight][b]CROSSBOW: Bloodnight[/b][/url])

All this is a huge step for Hyperstrange (or a whole marathon, actually), as a small indie studio with just one game published a year ago, to a... slightly larger indie studio that's becoming a hub of game development and publishing. If you're reading this - please know, that you have our utmost gratitude - we couldn't have done any of this without the tremendous support our games are receiving from the Steam community! That is it for today,[b] be excellent to each other![/b]
